Title: SA111
Product Description:
The acoustic sound panels with integrated speaker CinemAtelier™ are part of the collection Architectural Acoustic Solution. The collection is the result of 15 years of constant acoustic innovation, aiming at offering the best acoustic comfort solution to any environment.

Tailor-made acoustic panels with integrated loudspeaker

CinemAtelier combines Atelier acoustic panels, a product of high-quality, Made in Italy manufacture, with the high fidelity of Garvan loudspeakers. The acoustic sound panels can be installed next to or under the TV and they feature integrated speakers, for a customised sound solution.

Tailor-made acoustic solutions for your TV

CinemAtelier™ panels are tailor-made, to perfectly adapt to the size of any kind of screen, guaranteeing an unparalleled acoustic and aesthetic result. Perfect integration and ease of installation are two fundamental elements distinguishing the collection.

Italian craftsmanship and high customisation possibilities

CinemAtelier™ acoustic sound panels are characterized by the excellent quality of Italian craftsmanship. The fabric covering the surface also covers the side surfaces and adds to the product a sartorial effect, particularly suitable for interior design. CinemAtelier™ is available in a wide range of finishes, colors, and custom graphics. The fireproof acoustic fabric in Trevira CS yarn offers a velvety tactile experience and is similar to cotton.

CinemAtelier™ allows reducing indoor noise and reverberation, thus offering the guests an improved and pleasant acoustic experience. Thanks to the soundproofing features of the panels combined with the high-quality sound of the integrated speakers, CinemAtelier™ will let you experience intense emotions like you were at the cinema.
Thumbnail:alt: 2 way coax ACOUSTIC SOUND PANELS

Title: SA117
Product Description:
The 360° SA117 outdoor case, enhanced with Corian®, is designed for outdoor listening and architectural placement. With its minimalist design and maximum power in the smallest footprint, it enriches even the most sought-after outdoor spaces. The 360-degree, natural and airy sound provides a superior listening experience.

NEW MARBLE EFFECT STONEWARE FINISH

For our SA117 outdoor speaker, we introduce the new marble-effect stoneware finish, combining all-around sound excellence with timeless design. This element is designed to blend seamlessly with the aesthetics of outdoor environments, maintaining its elegance and functionality in all weather conditions

CREATED FOR YOUR OUTDOOR SPACES

LOTO diffusers are made to be installed outdoors and are characterized by an essential, geometric design. Fixing is optimized for swimming pools, parks, terraces, verandas. Diffusers can be made of Corian and in a wide choice of finishes.

SUPERIOR OUTDOOR LISTENING EXPERIENCE

Each speaker is designed and built with the goal of superior audio performance. The sound is natural, airy and spreads in all directions, minimizing the number of speakers needed, thanks to the acoustic lens and the maximum ratio of power to footprint.In addition, the electronic components are state-of-the-art, the speakers are designed by Garvan and made in Italy and tested one by one.

ROBUSTNESS

Title: SVK15
Product Description:
Goccia is the only hanging speaker that blends natural sound diffusion with design and art. A decorative piece of furniture, totally made in Faenza’s ceramic, with a timeless design, suspended from the ground thanks to state-of-the-art components.


Pure sound

Garvan’s concept of “pure sound” draws inspiration from an ideal suspended spherical loudspeaker, which recreates a real-life acoustic condition, providing a natural and crystal-clear sound. This is made possible by state-of-the-art components, Italian craftsmanship and individual tuning of each speaker.

Timeless design

Our timeless design allows bringing the possibilities of suspended lighting techniques into your sound diffusion solutions, creating refined pieces of furniture, with sinuous shapes inspired by nature, available in various colours.

A unique ceramic work of art from Faenza

Every ceramic product is unique and unrepeatable, because it is manufactured individually by the expert hands of the Masters of the well-known Gatti Ceramic Workshop in Faenza. Exclusive finishes are available drawing from our culture and history: traditional decoration patterns from Faenza, a motorbike theme inspired by the Misano World Circuit and signed by the renowned designer Aldo Drudi (ADI Golden Compass Award), breath-taking pearl effects, noble metals (gold, platinum and copper), and the “Riflesso” effect, a unique ceramic technique whose secret has remained unknown for over a century.
